notes.title: Bunny's Trail is available!
notes.content:
[b]Bunny's trail[/b] is a game to test your memory, observe the scene for a few seconds and memorize the carrots positions, avoid the threats and collect all carrots.

Do you have good memory?
Observe the scene for a few seconds and memorize the position of the items. Avoid obstacles and collect all carrots.

About the game
Bunny's Trail is the second game from Bunny's Collection, is a colorful 3D Puzzle game, navigate a little rabbit and go through the safe path to collect all the hidden carrots. Enjoy this cute and relaxing game for all ages.

Features

40 Levels in Early Access
Simple Controls
Original soundtracks
Partial Controller Support
Cute and colorful graphics

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431190/Bunnys_Trail/
